'''Erglush''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. The buildings in Erglush were made up of mud and organic material. It was connected to [[Outworlder City]] by the [[Living Monorail]] that was made out of a very thick vine.<ref name="PoG2" />
